snippet.title: PV2　"Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino"
snippet.description:
第二弾PV
『狐ト蛙ノ旅』というゲームを開発しています。

We are developing a game called "Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino" 
It’s a 3D action/adventure game focused on the exploration of a mysterious island inspired by Japanese folklore.
